pred_texts: Instruct: First get a large pot and fill it halfway with water.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now turn on the heat to high.
Instruct: Now get two cups of pasta and add it to the pot on the stove.
Instruct: Now add one tablespoon of salt.
Instruct: Now stir the pasta so that the salt is well mixed.
Instruct: Now we have to wait for the pasta to be done. Meanwhile, while the pasta cooks, get another medium-sized pan and put it on the stove.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now add two tablespoons of butter to the empty pan on the stove.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now add one tablespoon of olive oil to the pan.
Instruct: Now get about 200 grams of mushroom and wash them.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now cut the mushroom into small pieces.
Instruct: Now add the mushrooms to the pan.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now turn on the heat of the pan with the mushrooms to medium.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now stir the mushroom and the butter together.
Instruct: Now just let them cook without stirring for about two minutes.
Instruct: Now stir the butter and the mushroom mixture thoroughly.
Instruct: Now let the mushrooms cook without stirring for about one and half minutes.
Feedback: You are stirring the mushrooms, but the instruction requires you to let them cook without stirring for about one and a half minutes.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now stir the mushroom mixture thoroughly.
Instruct: Now add about one teaspoon of garlic paste to the mushrooms in the pen.
Instruct: Now add about one teaspoon of oregano seasoning.
Instruct: Now turn the heat down to medium-low and mix the ingredients together well.
Instruct: Now let it cook in low heat for about two minutes. Then give it a stir and turn off the heat.
Instruct: Now we should check if the pasta is cooked. You can take one pasta out and cut it to check if the pasta is done.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now drain the pasta water and but set aside one cup of the pasta water.
Instruct: Now add the pasta into the pan with the mushrooms.
Instruct: Now add the one cup of the remaining pasta water to the pasta.
Instruct: Now turn the heat of the stove with the mushrooms back on to medium.
Instruct: Now give mushroom pasta a nice stir so that the pasta and the mushrooms are well integrated.
Instruct: Now add about five tablespoons of grated parmesan cheese.
Instruct: Now cook for about two minutes while stirring the ingredients continuously.
Instruct: Now you can turn off the heat.
Success: Step complete.
